text: Jaguar Land Rover (JLR) achieved record free cash flow of £2.3 billion in FY24, reducing net debt to £0.7 billion while accelerating the Reimagine EV luxury roadmap. Range Rover Electric waitlist crossed 38,000 orders.

Tata Passenger Electric Mobility maintained market leadership with >70% EV market share in India. Launched Punch.ev on the pure acti.ev architecture with 421 km certified range. EV penetration reached 13% of domestic car portfolio.
Tata Motors Board approved the demerger into two separate listed entities: Commercial Vehicles (CV) business and Passenger Vehicles (PV + EV + JLR) to unlock shareholder value and operational focus.

Tata Electronics is investing $11 Billion to construct India's first commercial semiconductor fabrication plant in Dholera, Gujarat, with PSMC partnership, providing in-house automotive chip supply chain security.

Reliance Retail expanded physical store presence to 18,774 locations covering 79.1 million sq.ft. Digital commerce and merchant partnerships contributed 19% of total retail revenue. Annual footfalls crossed 1 billion customers.

Jio Infocomm expanded subscriber base to 481.8 million with true 5G subscribers exceeding 108 million. Monthly per capita data consumption reached 28.7 GB, driving ARPU expansion to Rs 181.7 per month.

Capital expenditure of Rs 1,31,000 Crore was allocated toward the Dhirubhai Ambani Green Energy Giga Complex in Jamnagar, targeting integrated solar PV, green hydrogen, and battery storage manufacturing.
Oil-to-Chemicals (O2C) segment revenue rose to Rs 5,64,000 Crore with fuel refining margins supported by favorable middle distillate cracks and flexible crude feedstock sourcing.

TCS delivered revenue of $29.1 billion, growing 4.1% YoY in constant currency, with an operating margin of 24.6% and Free Cash Flow to Net Income conversion of 104%. Total Contract Value (TCV) stood at $42.7 billion.

TCS expanded its dedicated Semiconductor & Silicon Engineering business unit, partnering with 8 of the top 10 global fabless chip designers on advanced 3nm and 2nm node verification and automotive software.
TCS AI WisdomNext platform launched to orchestrate multi-model generative AI deployments across Fortune 500 financial services and healthcare clients, deploying over 100 enterprise GenAI pilots.
Infosys Topaz AI platform signed $4.5 billion in total contract value (TCV) in FY24, integrating generative AI into enterprise workflows across North American banking and manufacturing accounts.
FY25 revenue guidance targeted at 1.0% to 3.0% in constant currency with operating margin band maintained at 20.0% to 22.0% under Project Maximus operational efficiency framework.
Completed mega-merger with HDFC Limited, creating total assets of Rs 36.17 Lakh Crore. Net interest income grew 25.1% YoY, with advances growing 55.4% YoY post-merger integration.
Asset quality remained best-in-class with Gross NPA ratio of 1.24% and Net NPA of 0.33%. Provision Coverage Ratio (PCR) stood comfortably at 74% with zero systemic asset stress.
Core operating profit grew 18.3% YoY to Rs 58,122 Crore. Net Interest Margin (NIM) was 4.59% for the fiscal year, with domestic loan portfolio growing 16.8% YoY driven by retail and SME credit.

doc_title: State Bank of India Annual Report FY24
text: State Bank of India achieved record annual Net Profit of Rs 61,077 Crore, with Return on Assets (RoA) crossing 1.04% and Return on Equity (RoE) reaching 20.32%. Gross NPA fell to a 10-year low of 2.24%.
Airtel pan-India 5G deployment reached 20,000+ towns, driving ARPU to an industry-leading Rs 209 per month. Mobile services revenue in India grew 11.2% YoY supported by premium subscriber upgrades.
Data Center revenue grew 217% to $47.5 billion, driven by hyperscalers deploying H100 and A100 Tensor Core GPUs for foundational LLM training and multimodal AI model inference.
Blackwell architecture introduces B200 GPU with 208 billion transistors and GB200 NVL72 rack-scale systems delivering up to 30x real-time inference speedups at 25x lower energy consumption.
Services revenue reached an all-time record of $85.2 billion, up 16% YoY, driven by over 1 billion paid subscriptions across iCloud, App Store, Apple Music, and Apple Pay.
Microsoft Cloud revenue reached $135.3 billion, growing 23% YoY. Azure grew 29% YoY with 8 percentage points contributed directly by enterprise Azure OpenAI customer workloads.
Tata Motors inaugurated a new manufacturing line in Sanand targeting 300,000 EVs per annum.
